hypothesis: Order points captures by victim board value plus earned points minus the petrifying capturer; retain surviving pawn and capture-promotion value. Better first moves may improve pruning and depth without changing the baseline good/bad SEE boundary.
implementation: src/movepick.cpp only: CAPTURES and capture EVASIONS; inverse adjustment retains the existing GOOD_CAPTURE SEE boundary. No changes to evaluation, SEE, pruning or quiet promotion ordering.
validation: Debug capture-order regression passed for both colors, en passant, promotions, evasions, TT priority, exact stage coverage and legacy MVV. Remaining validation precedes campaign launch.

baseline.name: run4test + winning-mate-r2
baseline.selection: Existing demonstrated run4test champion with the mandatory winning-mate correctness fix; no strength gain claimed for that fix. Rejected adapter-v1 is not used.

stopping: Displayed LOS 100.0% or 0.0%, minimum 40, drain complete color-reversed pairs and recheck; resume inside cap if boundary is lost. Run every TC. No boundary at cap => NEUTRAL_SCREEN for selection, not equivalence.
promotion: All three valid controls WIN; otherwise reject and preserve.
next_step: After closing all controls, run a separate points-aware capture-futility experiment on the resulting champion. Do not test another candidate concurrently.
coordination: Owner paused Misere; no cross-chat messages.
